description: Builds a deterministic, human-readable label for one tag cluster from its highest-weight member tags, per cluster_tags' TagClusterResult.cluster_labels requirement.
signature: def label_cluster(members: list[str], cooccurrence: pd.DataFrame) -> str
docstring:
Build a human-readable archetype label.

Args:
    members: Tag strings belonging to one cluster.
    cooccurrence: The full tag-by-tag co-occurrence count matrix (raw counts, not the Jaccard distance matrix) for the run, used to rank members by total within-run popularity.

Returns:
    A string joining the top 3 members (or fewer if the cluster has fewer than 3 tags) by total co-occurrence weight (row sum in `cooccurrence` restricted to `members`), separated by ' / ', e.g. 'Roguelike / Pixel Graphics / Difficult'. Deterministic: ties in weight are broken alphabetically.
preconditions: every tag in members is present in cooccurrence's index
postconditions: Calling label_cluster twice with identical inputs returns an identical string (determinism required by cluster_tags' own 'deterministic for a fixed input and seed' invariant)

edge_cases.input: A cluster with a single tag
edge_cases.expected_behavior: the label is exactly that one tag, no separator

edge_cases.input: Two members tie exactly on total co-occurrence weight
edge_cases.expected_behavior: the alphabetically earlier tag is listed first

edge_cases.input: A cluster with more than 3 tags
edge_cases.expected_behavior: only the top 3 by weight appear in the label; the rest are omitted from the label text but remain in TagClusterResult.cluster_members

unit_tests.name: test_single_tag_cluster_label
unit_tests.description: A one-tag cluster labels as just that tag.

unit_tests.name: test_top_three_by_weight_selected
unit_tests.description: A 5-tag cluster labels with exactly its top 3 by co-occurrence weight.
unit_tests.expected: 3 tags joined by ' / ', matching the expected top-3 order

unit_tests.name: test_tie_broken_alphabetically
unit_tests.description: Two equally-weighted tags are ordered alphabetically in the label.

unit_tests.name: test_deterministic_across_calls
unit_tests.description: Two calls with identical inputs return the identical string.
